Interface ExcelReadable

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.lang.AutoCloseable, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String[]>, Readable
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    EventExcelReader, ReadWorkbook, UpdateWorkbook

    public interface ExcelReadable
extends Readable
    Extends Readable with worksheet access and workbook-specific operations for spreadsheet formats that support multiple worksheets.

    Implementations provide access to worksheet names and counts, and allow individual worksheets to be selected and loaded into memory by name or zero-based index.
